info.name: Expedia Group EPS Deposit Bookings Notifications API

params.name: undeliverable
params.description: Undeliverable notifications are returned when this parameter is set to `true`.

params.name: billing_terms
params.description: This parameter is to specify the terms of how a resulting booking should be billed. If this field is needed, the value for this will be provided to you separately.

params.name: partner_point_of_sale
params.description: This parameter is to specify what point of sale is being used to shop and book. If this field is needed, the value for this will be provided to you separately.

params.name: payment_terms
params.description: This parameter is to specify what terms should be used when being paid for a resulting booking. If this field is needed, the value for this will be provided to you separately.

params.name: platform_name
params.description: This parameter is to specify what platform is being used to shop and book. If this field is needed, the value for this will be provided to you separately.

items.docs:
Use this API to fetch undelivered notifications. Up to 25 notifications are returned with each call.
Each undelivered notification will be returned only once.
